The chronic duration of 11 years, combined with copious thick, purulent sputum and recurrent infections despite antibiotic treatment, strongly points to bronchiectasis rather than simple chronic bronchitis. The chest X-ray findings of right middle lobe opacity and airway thickening support this structural diagnosis.
